title: Marketing Management for Hospitality and Tourism

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze and synthesize knowledge about marketing management in hospitality and tourism businesses.
Apply knowledge to analyze the impact of micro and macro environments on business operations in hospitality and tourism.
Identify market segments, target markets, and product positioning in hospitality and tourism.
Develop strategies for product design and pricing in hospitality and tourism.
Design and manage distribution channels in hospitality and tourism.
Manage integrated communication activities in hospitality and tourism.
Manage customer relationships and brand management in hospitality and tourism.
Develop marketing mix strategies in hospitality and tourism.
Conduct qualitative and quantitative market research in hospitality and tourism.
Collaborate effectively in teams to develop marketing plans and strategies.
Apply critical thinking to analyze and solve complex marketing problems in hospitality and tourism.
Demonstrate self-learning abilities to continuously improve marketing skills in hospitality and tourism.
Effectively present marketing plans and strategies to stakeholders in hospitality and tourism.
